matrix_role: tests for detention, corrections, health care, death-in-custody, release, Medicaid/benefits, identity documents, housing, RRC/home-confinement, supervision, and reentry continuity claims

CR-01.fail_or_repair: Open a custody-authority docket and downgrade any claim that treats a custody row as legal proof.
CR-01.label: Legal custody and hold state
CR-01.question: Does the packet separate arrest, booking, charge, sentence, hold, detainer, transfer, supervision violation, credits, and release authority before accepting custody as lawful or current?

CR-02.fail_or_repair: Treat booking as incomplete until high-risk triage and action receipts are visible.
CR-02.label: Intake and acute-risk triage
CR-02.question: Does the record prove suicide, withdrawal, medications, disability, pregnancy, age, language, victimization, mental health, and emergency medical risks were screened and acted on?

CR-03.fail_or_repair: Do not treat jail census, prison count, or classification as safe custody without conditions evidence.
CR-03.label: Conditions, violence, and segregation safety
CR-03.question: Can the packet join housing unit, staffing, violence, contraband, use of force, sexual abuse, segregation, sanitation, food, ADA accommodation, grievances, and monitoring?

CR-04.fail_or_repair: Open a health passport; do not accept sick-call or referral status as care continuity.
CR-04.label: Health, medication, and MOUD continuity
CR-04.question: Can the packet prove medical records, medications, MOUD, chronic care, mental health, hospital transfer, disability supports, pregnancy care, and release prescriptions continued across custody and discharge?

CR-05.fail_or_repair: Do not cite annual death statistics as accountability until incident-level investigation and repair tails are joined.
CR-05.label: Death, injury, and serious-incident accountability
CR-05.question: Does a death or serious incident connect DCRA/MCI reporting, incident narrative, investigation, family notice, public denominator, corrective action, and litigation or monitor status?

CR-06.fail_or_repair: Treat communication blockage as a liberty and due-process risk, not as facility administration.
CR-06.label: Communication, counsel, family, and grievance access
CR-06.question: Does the packet prove attorney/court access, phone/mail/video, family notice, interpreter, disability accommodation, grievance, and retaliation-safe reporting remained available?

CR-07.fail_or_repair: Do not treat projected release date as release until gate execution and downstream conditions are visible.
CR-07.label: Release calculation and gate execution
CR-07.question: Can the record prove credits, FSA/good time, parole/release eligibility, detainers, transportation, property, gate time, medications, and discharge instructions were executed?

CR-08.fail_or_repair: Do not accept application, referral, or demonstration authority as continuity until usable benefits and documents are confirmed.
CR-08.label: Benefits, IDs, and coverage bridge
CR-08.question: Does the packet prove Medicaid/coverage, ID documents, Social Security card, birth certificate, address, phone, appointments, records, and consent were usable at release?

CR-09.fail_or_repair: Do not treat reentry referral or supervision compliance flag as stable community return.
CR-09.label: Housing, treatment, work, and supervision tail
CR-09.question: Does release connect to RRC/home confinement, shelter or housing, employment/education, treatment, family reunification, supervision conditions, fees, electronic monitoring, and violation/modification route?

CR-10.fail_or_repair: Downgrade claims that cite BJS, CMS, GAO, SAMHSA, BOP, or DOJ sources outside their evidentiary boundary.
CR-10.label: Source posture and denominator boundary
CR-10.question: Does the packet mark which sources are aggregate counts, live program rules, oversight findings, mortality records, or local case files before drawing conclusions?
